title: Angsa Bu Kos
subject: a student in Yogyakarta whose kos landlady keeps a goose that guards the gate and chases him every night he comes home after ten, so he learns to dodge it in a shoulder-shaking dance
caption: Indonesian breakbeat kejut bahu (BKB), bar-floor breakbeat style. Chopped amen-style breakbeat drums with snappy snare rolls, rubbery saw bass bouncing on offbeats, short detuned stab synth chords, rave hoover sweeps into each drop. Loud compressed club mix, wide stereo. Cheeky male mid-register vocal, half shouted, half sung, rhythmic and playful. 148 BPM, A minor. Mood of a silly late-night chase turned into a dance. No trap hi-hats, no autotune, no dangdut kendang, no EDM supersaw build, no slow ballad section.
lyrics:
[Intro - breakbeat drums, hoover sweep]
[Verse 1]
Jam sepuluh lewat dikit
Gerbang kos udah dikunci
Bu Kos tidur di depan TV
Angsanya melotot di sini
[Pre-Chorus]
Leher panjang, sayap dibuka
Aku mundur satu langkah
[Chorus]
Kiri, kanan, goyang bahu
Angsa Bu Kos ngejar aku
Kiri, kanan, jangan berhenti
Sandal jepit ketinggalan lagi
[Verse 2]
Bawa roti buat sogokan
Dia makan, terus nyosor juga
Tetangga kamar ngintip jendela
Videoin aku tiap malam
[Chorus]
Kiri, kanan, goyang bahu
Angsa Bu Kos ngejar aku
Kiri, kanan, satu dua tiga
Sekarang dia ikut joget juga
[Outro - breakbeat drops out, hoover tail]
Bu Kos bangun, ketawa aja
Besok aku pulang jam sembilan
